description: Source code for the eS-WiFi SPI bus driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing SPI communication, command handling, and message polling for the eS-WiFi module.

methods.name: eswifi_spi_init
methods.description: Initializes the SPI bus and GPIO for the eS-WiFi module, starts polling thread.

methods.name: eswifi_spi_request
methods.description: Handles sending commands and receiving data over SPI with proper protocol handling.

methods.name: eswifi_spi_read_msg
methods.description: Reads asynchronous messages from the eS-WiFi module.

methods.name: eswifi_spi_poll_thread
methods.description: Thread function that periodically polls for messages from the module.
